name: adb-plugin-custom-commands
description: Create custom slash, text, and context menu commands with variable templates and embed responses.
author: DeadIndian

process.persistentReason: Runs un-isolated (system:raw-client) to inspect client.commands ownership, create/edit/delete guild application commands, reply to prefix messages, and use full slash/context-menu interactions. These discord.js APIs are outside the sandboxed RPC surface.

view.empty: You haven't used any custom commands in this server.

permissions.label: View
permissions.description: See custom commands and their responses.

permissions.label: Configure
permissions.description: Change the text command prefix and plugin settings.

permissions.label: Manage commands
permissions.description: Create, edit, and delete custom commands.
